## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The JSON lookahead should preserve following options: requesting the default JSON destination before `--junit` currently prevents report generation.

## Changes
The pull request adds optional JSON destinations, report-file writing, and tests for JSON and JUnit arguments. This review read the tests without running them.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cli.py:15 — correctness — Preserve following flags when JSON uses its default — With `["--json", "--junit", "x.xml"]`, parsing raises `ValueError("unknown option: x.xml")` instead of selecting both reports. Your lookahead consumes `--junit` as the JSON path because it checks only whether another argument exists. — Users cannot generate reports when they place default-destination JSON before JUnit, making option order unexpectedly determine success. — Fix: Guard both destination assignment and argument consumption against a following option, and extend `test_json_default_and_explicit_path`.
